title: The novelty exposed: ablation, reproducibility and transparency in 40 technical reports of open-weight large language models (LLMs)
abstract: arXiv:2611.20003v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In 2025 alone, 48 new large language model (LLM) architectures were added to the Hugging Face transformers library, and many of them arrive with a technical report that presents the model as new. What is actually new in these models, and is it tested? We put this question to LLM technical reports. We look at three things: what the reference code shows about how new open-weight architectures differ from earlier ones; what 40 randomly sampled technical reports claim as new and whether they support it with ablation studies; and what they disclose for reproducibility and transparency. In the library, 39 of the 48 architectures added in 2025 take at least two of their three core blocks from another model, most often Llama, although part of this reflects how the library writes code. translated_title: 揭示新颖性：40份开放权重大型语言模型（LLM）技术报告中的消融实验、可复现性与透明度
translated_abstract: 仅在2025年，就有48种新的大型语言模型（LLM）架构被添加到Hugging Face transformers库中，其中许多模型都附有一份将其呈现为创新之作的技术报告。这些模型究竟有什么真正新颖之处，以及这些新颖之处是否经过测试？我们将这一问题抛给了LLM技术报告。我们考察三个方面：参考代码显示了新的开放权重架构与早期架构有何不同；40份随机抽样的技术报告声称了哪些新颖之处，以及它们是否用消融实验来支持这些声明；以及它们为可复现性和透明度披露了哪些信息。在该库中，2025年添加的48种架构中有39种的三个核心模块中至少有两个来自其他模型，最常见的是Llama，尽管其中部分原因反映了该库编写代码的方式。在报告中，73项架构或训练新颖性声明中仅有19项附带受控的有/无对比实验；40份报告中有4份声明了不止一次完整训练运行……
tldr: 该研究通过分析Hugging Face库代码与40份随机抽样的开放权重LLM技术报告，发现2025年新增的48种架构大多复用现有模型（以Llama为主）的核心模块，且73项新颖性声明中仅19项有消融实验支持，揭示了当前LLM技术报告在新颖性验证、可复现性和透明度方面的普遍不足。
en_tdlr: By analyzing Hugging Face library code and 40 randomly sampled open-weight LLM technical reports, this study reveals that most of the 48 architectures added in 2025 reuse core blocks from existing models (mostly Llama), and only 19 of 73 novelty claims are backed by ablation studies, exposing widespread deficiencies in novelty validation, reproducibility, and transparency in current LLM technical reports.
